text:
maya: Heads-up — CI went red on linux-x86 after today's gcc image bump. Bazel failing on //android/protos:protos_gen with a missing cc_library error. Anyone seen this?

liam: I can repro locally. Error during genrule:
```
ERROR: /workspace/android/protos/BUILD:14:1: //android/protos:protos_gen: no such target '//third_party/protobuf:cc': target not declared in package
```

buildbot: CI shard linux-x86 FAILED — https://ci.internal/redwood/12345 (log attached).

sasha: Quick thought — did the protobuf toolchain change outputs in the new gcc image? Last time a compiler/image bump shuffled generated paths and proto cc targets broke.

maya: Good call. @liam can you check whether the generated protos used to be under third_party/protobuf/gen/ and now under third_party/protobuf/out/? If so we need a mapping fix in our android rules.

liam: Checking. Running a small repro with `bazel build //android/protos:protos_gen --sandbox_debug` now. Will share diff of tree.

eng-bot: RERUN requested by maya — rerunning linux-x86 with env var PROTO_DEBUG=1.

liam: Minimal repro: previously `bazel-bin/third_party/protobuf/libprotos.a` existed. After image bump only `bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/genfiles/third_party/protobuf/libprotos.a` shows up. Our BUILD references pre-bazel-out path.

sasha: If generated outputs moved under bazel-out, the right fix is to reference the declared target //third_party/protobuf:cc in deps, not a hard path. Might be a temporary compatibility change in the compiler image.

maya: Can we do a quick CI rerun with a fallback: pin the gcc image back to v2026-03-15 for linux-x86 shards while we fix? @buildbot can you trigger an emergency rollback job?

buildbot: Created ticket RB-452; triggered rollback run — link: https://ci.internal/redwood/12346 (queued).

liam: I started a bisect between gcc-image-2026-03-15 and gcc-image-2026-03-16 using our image-bisect script. First failing image found: gcc-image-2026-03-16. Repro confirmed.

maya: OK — can you open a tiny fix PR that updates android/protos/BUILD to depend on //third_party/protobuf:cc (not hard paths) and mark as hotfix? Keep the change minimal.

liam: Drafted CL: https://phabricator.redwood/CL7890 — changes BUILD deps and adds a note about image compatibility. Running tests locally, then will push.

sasha: After CL lands, we should add a smoke in our infra tests that validates generated proto outputs exist via declared targets, to catch path shuffles. Filing follow-up: INFRA-301.

maya: Awesome — thanks. Leaving the rollback job running until CL merges + green. :thumbsup:

liam: CL pushed and uploaded. CI rerun passing on linux-x86 with pinned image; will watch for green on the rollback job and then request promote.

maya: Great work all.
